scripts.db:types: node supabase/scripts/supabase-wsl.mjs gen types typescript --local > .types.tmp && node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('.types.tmp','utf8'); if(!s.startsWith('export type Json')) { console.error('db:types falhou (o Supabase local está de pé?):', s.slice(0,140)); process.exit(1);} require('fs').renameSync('.types.tmp','src/app/shared/database.types.ts')"
scripts.db:revisao-reset: docker exec -i supabase_db_conquest psql -U postgres -d postgres -f - < supabase/scripts/resetar-revisao.sql
scripts.db:dono: docker exec -i supabase_db_conquest psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f - < supabase/scripts/promover-dono.sql
scripts.db:conferir-acesso: docker exec -i supabase_db_conquest psql -U postgres -d postgres -f - < supabase/scripts/conferir-acesso.sql
